_what: Catchment areas pinned from a named document, overriding what the mapped network and MERIT infer at that point. Inputs only — never an output, never a capacity, never anything fitted to make a prediction match a built plant.
_rule: An entry needs a source a stranger could check. 'It looked wrong' is not a source; a licence document, a feasibility study, a DHM publication or a published headworks figure is. Anything without one belongs in the code as a documented failure, not in here as a correction.
_whyNotMore: Nepal's public gauge records carry flows, not catchment areas, so there is no bulk import to do here. This table grows one sourced document at a time and is deliberately small.

overrides.name: Upper Tamakoshi headworks
overrides.source: Upper Tamakoshi Hydropower Project, published headworks catchment 1745 km2; position is OSM 'Upper Tamakoshi Headworks Diversion Dam' (way centre), the same coordinate pipeline/plants.json cites. MERIT reads about 1741 km2 here, so this entry changes almost nothing and exists as the worked example of the format.
